verdicts.reason: The two candidates look the same at this size, so neither is the better resize. In both, the woman on the left is cropped down to an unrecognisable sliver, and the second photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed against the right edge. The 'ONLINE TRAINING BY / FREYA ANOUK' bars are so small they can't be read at banner size, and the headline crowds right up against them with almost no gap, so the yellow brand blocks and the original's two-photo feel are mostly lost.
